string.text: Hello, I'm Peri. I've grown up a lot since before, you know. Huh? You heard my name from an underground broker?
Good morning, Commander. You look dashing today too! I'd better give it my all as well.
What I'm doing? Oh, I was looking through the recent procurement logs. Don't worry, we won't lose out in that respect as long as I'm around, so don't worry.
Ok Peri, enough for now. Please head back to base.
